source_native_receipts: Reused and bound by the baseline inventory; this round only reran semantic admission.

reviews.basis: The modified URL is relative but no base_url is configured. MockTransport does not remove the client URL/cookie preconditions. The failure precedes the decoding assertions.
Open("") and Open("d1") identify different databases in the same filesystem. The test requires the new empty database to preserve statistics from the first one.
CSI 65;4u supplies modifier 4 and no event-type subparameter. The test retains release despite the default press phase.
Mismatched MIME boundary must raise DecodingError. Stream iteration must consume and close the response. The guarded normal-result check stays dormant. The native failure is the required close state.
The issue requires ctrl+plus as an alternate alias. The changed ctrl+shift+equals_sign key with shifted_key plus exposes a missing alias while retaining valid stored metadata.

The generated command uses POSIX shlex.quote. IPython magic_arguments delegates to arg_split with posix=False. The issue requires a path argument but does not settle this shell-concatenation grammar. Do not assume arbitrary POSIX shell quoting is required.

ordered(relation()) returns an ordered-list Trait, not the underlying Relation. The test uses its result as a relation pair constructor and as the targetsFor relation. Existing ordered API documentation and type declarations distinguish these roles.

The supplied pipe/transform composition maps each string value to its length. The recursive schema must apply the transformation at every node; input type rejection and self-reference identity remain justified.
The changed theirs version replaces/deletes a region overlapping the ours edit. The issue requires conflict markers, index stages and merge metadata. The execution incorrectly returns no conflict.
A Target is not a pathlib.Path. The generated test assigns Target(...) to tmp and then uses tmp / filename. The source class supplies neither __truediv__ nor a path subclass contract.

The supplied alternate shifted code point changes from uppercase A to q (113). The retained A/shift+a and A-character checks no longer match the protocol input. The issue example A is not a requirement to ignore explicit alternate key codes.
Width 100 admits all six visible characters. The test still expects a truncated tail. The model basis incorrectly describes an untruncated expected value that is absent from the fixed program.

decision: Not promoted. The source-ranked first-supported policy exposes wrong setup and stale-oracle false alarms. Use as measured baseline for repair and evidence retrieval experiments.
